facts.fact: According to Universal Ads' CES 2026 takeaways, roughly half of the advertisers the company spoke with are already implementing incrementality as part of their core measurement strategy.
facts.quote: Roughly half of the advertisers we spoke with are already implementing incrementality as part of their core measurement strategy.

facts.fact: Universal Ads published its blog post 'AI, CTV & Measurement: Key Takeaways from CES 2026' with a byline date of January 16, 2026.
